# By free type

## Permanent free tier

- [Cohere (trial keys)](providers.md#cohere): 20 RPM. Trial keys: 1,000 API calls per month, 20 RPM for chat. Trial keys are for evaluation, not production or commercial use.
- [Google AI Studio (Gemini API)](providers.md#gemini): see notes. Per project and per model. Google publishes which models are free on the pricing page; exact RPM/RPD show inside AI Studio after sign-in.
- [Groq](providers.md#groq): 30 RPM, 1K RPD, 8K TPM, 200K TPD. Per model, shared by all keys in one organization. 429 responses carry retry-after.
- [LLM7.io](providers.md#llm7) ⚠️ unclear: see notes. No free allowance found on 2026-11-20: the docs publish no rate limits (the old limits page is gone), and the live model catalog lists only priced, usage-based models. The four turbo models cost about $0.01–0.06 per 1M input tokens.
- [Mistral (Free mode)](providers.md#mistral): see notes. Monthly allowance shared across Studio, API and Vibe CLI; the Free-mode amount is not published. Per-model RPS/TPM shown in the console.
- [NVIDIA NIM (build.nvidia.com)](providers.md#nvidia): 40 RPM. About 40 RPM per account on models marked Free Endpoint; ceilings vary by model and load.
- [OpenRouter (:free models)](providers.md#openrouter): 20 RPM, 50 RPD. 20 RPM; 50 free-model requests per UTC day, or 1000 per day once 10 credits have been bought (all-time).
- [Requesty (free plan)](providers.md#requesty): 200 RPD. Free plan: free models only, 200 requests per day.
- [Z.ai (GLM Flash models)](providers.md#zai): see notes. GLM-4.7-Flash, GLM-4.5-Flash and GLM-4.6V-Flash have free input and output. No numeric rate limit is published.

## Renewing credit

- [Cloudflare Workers AI](providers.md#cloudflare): 300 RPM. 10,000 neurons per day free (resets 00:00 UTC), shared across all models; 300 RPM for text generation. Past the allowance calls fail.
- [Hugging Face Inference Providers](providers.md#huggingface) ❌ retired: see notes. Free accounts no longer get monthly inference credits (billing table lists None since about 2026-10-08).
- [Ollama Cloud](providers.md#ollama-cloud) ⚠️ unclear: see notes. A monthly starter allowance was announced, but the current pricing page describes pay-as-you-go. Check your account before relying on it.

## Trial credit (one-time)

- [Cerebras Inference](providers.md#cerebras): 5 RPM. Trial: $5 of credit for 30 days; needs a verified payment method. gpt-oss-120b 5 RPM, qwen-3.8-27b 300 RPM.
- [Sarvam AI](providers.md#sarvam): 60 RPM. ₹100 one-time starter credit; 60 RPM on the starter tier.

## Keyless (no sign-up)

- [Kilo Code gateway (anonymous)](providers.md#kilo): see notes. Anonymous use: 200 requests per hour per IP, :free models and the kilo-auto/free router only.
- [OVHcloud AI Endpoints (anonymous)](providers.md#ovh): 2 RPM. Anonymous: 2 requests per minute per IP and per model. API keys are paid (per token).
- [Pollinations.AI (legacy text API)](providers.md#pollinations) ⚠️ unclear: see notes. Legacy keyless host, one model (gpt-oss-20b). No current published rate limit. The new gen.pollinations.ai needs a key and credits.

## Local (your machine)

- [llama.cpp server (local)](providers.md#llama-cpp): see notes. No quota. Lowest memory use of the local options; good on CPU-only machines.
- [LM Studio (local)](providers.md#lm-studio): see notes. No quota. Desktop app with a model browser and an OpenAI-compatible server.
- [Ollama (local)](providers.md#ollama): see notes. No quota. Speed depends on your CPU/GPU and RAM; on 8 GB RAM without a GPU stick to 1.5B–3B models.
